title: cenchrus unisetus
intro: Cenchrus unisetus, commonly known as Pearl Millet, is a type of cereal grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Cenchrus unisetus include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and saponins. These bioactive constituents also contribute to the plant's potential anti-cancer and anti-diabetic properties.
